svg.title: workstation-steward: known vulnerabilities, the fixes it can take, and a tool switched off
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in three scenes; the commands and output are real, from one Mac on 2 November 2026, trimmed where a line says "more". steward sc vulns checks mise's tools, the packages inside them, Go programs by their module lists, Homebrew formulae through brew vulns, the npm -g packages and Node, and lists one row per tool with serious advisories: Homebrew formulae with no fixed release, and tools whose packages carry advisories that their next release fixes, Ruflo and Node's own npm among them. Three coverage lines say what it read: 38 of 66 mise tools, 68 of 92 Homebrew formulae, and that apps, the App Store, macOS updates and Docker images are not covered here. steward sc vulns-fix plans the fixes it can take: removing old, unused installs that carry serious advisories, while Homebrew formulae with no fixed release wait; plan only, it changes nothing. steward sc isolate plans switching gitnexus off with mise's own disable_tools setting, keeping it installed, with the command that switches it back on.

text.tspan: brew espeak-ng 1.52.0 CVE-2023-49992 unknown, EPSS 35th percentile
coverage: mise: 38 of 66 tools read (18 by package, 20 Go programs by their modules); 28 not covered
coverage: Homebrew: 68 of 92 formulae read (24 skipped: brew vulns --list-skipped); casks not covered
coverage: apps, App Store, macOS updates, Docker images: not covered here (see steward sc audit)
[1/1] known vulnerabilities: installed and unused: 0 upgrade(s), 17 removal(s) (41s)
remove gh@2.102.0 (unused: GO-2026-6603, GO-2026-6612 and 15 more)
remove kubectl@1.37.1 (unused: GO-2026-6603, GO-2026-6612 and 16 more)
remove terraform@1.16.6 (unused: GO-2026-6603, GO-2026-6612 and 12 more)
waits brew espeak-ng 1.52.0: CVE-2023-49992, CVE-2023-49993 and 10 more: fixed upstream, unreleased
waits brew jpeg-xl 0.12.0: OSV-2022-608, OSV-2022-725: no fixed release yet
waits brew libssh2 1.11.1: OSV-2025-433: no fixed release yet
plan only. Add --apply to do it (asks first).
steward sc isolate npm:gitnexus --why "17 advisories inside, one critical; waits for a release"
isolate npm:gitnexus: 17 advisories inside, one critical; waits for a release
then mise reshim; send the change with steward config sync
it stays installed; steward sc isolate --undo npm:gitnexus --apply switches it back on
